   - From Frankfurt, fly to Krakow (Day 14 to Day 18). Note that Day 16 to Day 18 is already allocated to Oslo, so Krakow will cover Days 14, 15, and partially overlap with Oslo.
   - Finally, after Krakow, move to Naples (Day 19 to Day 23), but since we only have 18 days, we adjust this to fit within the remaining days. However, since we've already used up 18 days, Naples can start from Day 10 (after Frankfurt) and overlap with Krakow and Oslo appropriately.
